_comment: Ported from app/data/loot_tables.yml. A roll count is drawn from [rollsMin, rollsMax]; each roll picks one entry by weight and a count from [minCount, maxCount]. 'inject' replaces the hard-coded InventoryItem.scavenge_item (rand(10) + 25 of one material). An entry may name a lootbox item - that is the 'recursion'. Balance: a plain quantum cache (default table) returns ~90% of its 100-material cost; irradiation is what makes caches profitable. Check changes with Tools/balance.py.
